prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / character animation asset. Produce ONE isolated FULL-BODY transparent PNG cutout of a single young adult protagonist for a layered cut-paper romantic MV. Image 1 is the APPROVED CHARACTER IDENTITY sheet (top row woman, bottom row man), image 2 is the APPROVED FULL-BODY ART STYLE reference with both protagonists in the scene. Match that same face, hairstyle, elegant paper-doll anatomy, paper clothing material and fine cut-paper hair locks extremely faithfully. Output ONLY the requested ONE character, no other person, NO background scenery, no ground, no floor, no typography, no watermark, no shadow cast on a floor, no grid or reference sheet. Real transparent alpha background, not a painted checkerboard. Entire head/hair and soles of both shoes visible with transparent margins all around; portrait orientation, character large and high-resolution. Refined layered paper illustration with subtle paper fibre, clean curves and shallow paper-edge shading. Warm neutral lighting for compositing. Retain the attractive grown-up East Asian face, delicate naturally shaped nose and mouth, TWO anatomically correct brown almond eyes clearly visible, never a flat one-eyed profile. Hands natural, all limbs attached. No giant head, no baby, no rigid basic-SVG avatar. WOMAN ONLY, age 23, EXACT approved woman's shoulder-length dark chestnut bob, airy side-part locks, small pearl-gold earrings, gentle small smile, warm light skin. Camera directly front-facing, full body, shoulders level. Ivory collared long-sleeve blouse tucked into dusty-rose mid-calf pleated skirt, tiny dusty-rose loose ribbon at collar, dark brown low leather shoes, NO socks. Same clothing as approved woman. Right side of the IMAGE arm extends gently diagonally outward about 40 degrees from vertical, elbow soft, palm relaxed open upward near waist height; left side of IMAGE arm hangs down a little clear of torso. Both forearms and hands completely separate from skirt outline, enough transparent gap for animation rigging. Feet spaced naturally a small amount, both soles on same horizontal baseline. Adult fashion-illustration proportions about 6.5 heads tall, soft paper-edge shadows, keep face as sophisticated as reference, not reinterpreted.
